title: Workplace Scenario
body:
You have been assigned to prepare a section of the presentation that summarizes recent products launched by NextGen's competitors. Sam is working on another section of the same presentation.

For this task, you use OpenAssist individually on your own computer. You ask OpenAssist to identify recent products launched by competing companies and other relevant competitors to examine. You review the information it provides and use it to prepare your section of the presentation.

body:
You have been assigned to prepare a section of the presentation summarizing lessons learned from a recently completed project at NextGen. As you work on the section, you begin to feel uncertain about whether you have captured the most important takeaways. Sam is working on another section of the same presentation.

For this task, you use OpenAssist individually on your own computer. You tell OpenAssist that you feel uncertain about how you are approaching the task and ask it for reassurance and perspective. You consider its response and continue preparing your section of the presentation.
